description: High-performance Room Database clone for C# with Source Generators
releaseNotes:
v0.5.5

            This release focuses on batch operation generator fixes, performance improvements, benchmark updates, and documentation refinements.

            Highlights:
            - Fixed Batch Delete and Batch Update source generators.
            - Improved performance and stability across generated DAO paths.
            - Refined TodoBenchmarks coverage comparing RoomSharp, Dapper, and EF Core.
            - Improved benchmark documentation and related usage guidance.
            
            v0.5.4

            Core Runtime Hardening:
            - Fixed transaction command clone cache identity by keying per-transaction cloned commands by DbCommand reference identity.
            - Transactional seeders now run through RoomDatabase.RunInTransactionAsync so seeder raw commands, DAO calls, and journal writes share the same transaction/session.
            - Serialized RunInTransactionAsync now uses async gate/transaction paths with caller CancellationToken support while waiting for the transaction lock and opening the transaction.
            - GlobalFilterRegistry.Disable(...) now handles out-of-order scope disposal without clearing newer disable scopes.
            - Pager<T> now keeps page cursor state local to each enumeration and uses PagingSource.DefaultPageSize.
            - MySQL and SQL Server FTS search SQL now targets quoted search columns instead of the FTS table name.

            Documentation:
            - Added v0.5.4 website documentation, release notes, changelog entries, and a separate technical-details page for previously undocumented core/runtime changes.

            v0.5.3
            
            RoomSharp v0.5.3 is an ecosystem alignment release.
            Starting with v0.5.3, RoomSharp uses synchronized versioning across ecosystem packages. Packages released as part of the same ecosystem update now share the same version number.
            RoomSharp is a multi-package ecosystem. Patch releases may stabilize generator, runtime, provider, CLI, and extension behavior together. Feature releases are followed by short stabilization cycles.
            Recommendation: keep all RoomSharp packages on the same version when using multiple packages together.

            v0.5.2

            Highlights:
            - [SoftDelete] generated DAO restore/hard-delete methods now live directly on DAO implementations.
            - [SoftDelete] DAO [Query] methods now auto-filter deleted rows at prepare-time.
            - [Encrypted] properties are now automatically decrypted after generated SELECT queries.
            - [Auditable] entities now auto-populate CreatedAt/UpdatedAt and support IAuditContext user tracking.

            Generated Code & Performance:
            - Parallel generated DAOs now use DbSession.GetOrCreateCommand(...) instead of shared DbCommand state.
            - Serialized generated DAOs now use shared DaoHelpers for transaction normalization, cached commands, and cloned-command disposal.
            - Reduced generated allocation/disposal overhead across DAO and DatabaseImpl code paths.
            - Insert generation now avoids unnecessary SQL Server fallback delegate allocations when fallback cannot run.
            - Relation loading caches column metadata and validates relation definitions earlier.
            - PagingSource now supports native async loaders with cancellation.

            Fixes:
            - Fixed GlobalFilter parameter binding in parallel generated SELECT queries.
            - Fixed QueryCache.InvalidateByPrefix() to return int as expected by QueryExtensions.
            - Fixed [Auditable] code generation to call IAuditContext.GetCurrentUser().
            - Fixed soft-delete generated SQL/parameter caching consistency in parallel mode.
            - Hardened ConnectionPool, bulk insert cleanup, migration lock release, ObservableQuery cancellation, FTS SQL quoting, and legacy query cache behavior.

            Docs & Coverage:
            - Added README coverage for GlobalFilters and other previously undocumented features.
            - Added generator/runtime tests covering soft-delete caching, serialized helper usage, insert fallback rules, GlobalFilter parameter binding, infrastructure cleanup, relation metadata, paging cancellation, and cache single-flight behavior.
